milestones.title: M0 Foundation
milestones.description: Repo, CI and preview deploys green; empty app live with owner verification.

milestones.title: M1 Catalog
milestones.description: Trustworthy discoverable catalog: US provider correctness and freshness verified, with 20k+ movies and 5k+ series as coverage targets, not proof of quality.

milestones.title: M2 Recommender
milestones.description: Useful, valid and diverse picks beat a documented baseline in reviewed cases; cold start and deterministic fallback work; latency and quota enforcement verified.

milestones.title: M3 Product UI
milestones.description: Phone/laptop guest can reach useful picks within 60 seconds via optional quiz or cold start, edit answers and understand availability and reasons.

milestones.title: M4 Accounts and polish
milestones.description: Optional sign-in sync, installable PWA and accessibility pass.

milestones.title: M5 Beta
milestones.description: Twenty real users provide consented evidence on relevance, first-use speed and streaming accuracy; improve failures before calling the beta successful.

issues.title: M0: Foundation — repo scaffold, CI, empty app live
issues.criteria: All M0 work merged with green CI; owner records successful main and PR preview URLs. Keep this umbrella issue open until the exit criteria pass.

issues.title: M0: Shared agent coordination and reproducible GitHub tracking
issues.criteria: Canonical shared rules, Claude/Grok pointers, repeatable dry-run setup, six milestones, 36 planned issues and a linked five-status board. Preserve existing issues and progress.

issues.title: M0: Fix and verify database migration setup
issues.criteria: The documented .env.local workflow works on a clean checkout. Apply migrations twice against fresh pgvector Postgres and verify the vector extension without exposing credentials.

issues.title: M0: Verify foundation on phone and laptop
issues.criteria: Exercise the production landing page on phone and desktop, test visible content and horizontal overflow, and report actual CI/browser evidence. Database verification is owned by #10 and aggregated by the lead in #3.

issues.title: M0: Owner setup — Vercel project, database and preview deployment
issues.criteria: Owner imports cinematch into Vercel, configures approved Postgres and secrets, verifies main and PR previews and supplies evidence. Agents document exact steps; account and billing clicks stay with owner. Keep deployment protected until the public release gate passes.

issues.title: M0: Document and enforce the public deployment gate
issues.criteria: Document per-session and per-IP LLM caps before any public link. Verify M0 exposes no paid inference route. Require protected deployment until quota enforcement is delivered and verified; include this gate in the owner deployment checklist.

issues.title: M1: Design catalog schema (movies, series, seasons, watch providers)
issues.criteria: Numbered migrations model titles, seasons, genres, keywords and US availability with source timestamps. Test constraints and indexes against Postgres; no episode recommendations.

issues.title: M1: TMDB client with rate limiting
issues.criteria: Server-only client with bounded retries, throttling, timeouts and redacted errors. Fixture tests cover pagination, rate limits, outages and malformed responses.

issues.title: M1: Bulk-ingest 20k+ movies and 5k+ series with metadata
issues.criteria: Resumable idempotent ingestion reaches 20k movies and 5k series, including overview, genres, keywords and season metadata. Report counts, failures and freshness without secrets.

issues.title: M1: US watch-provider availability + JustWatch/TMDB attribution
issues.criteria: Persist attributed US provider availability and timestamps. Distinguish provider information from verified playback deep links. Meet TMDB and JustWatch attribution requirements.

issues.title: M1: Nightly catalog + availability refresh (Vercel Cron)
issues.criteria: Authenticated nightly refresh has overlap prevention, bounded batches, resumable checkpoints and visible failures. Repeated runs are idempotent.

issues.title: M1: Catalog quality and availability freshness checks
issues.criteria: Repeatable audit reports counts, missing metadata, duplicate source IDs and stale availability. Document repair steps and demonstrate M1 exit counts.

issues.title: M1: Catalog search and quiz read endpoints
issues.criteria: Typed title search and deterministic quiz seeds support movies and series, bounded pagination, validation and provider metadata. Fixture tests cover errors and empty results.

issues.title: M2: Hosted embedding and reranker interfaces
issues.criteria: Swappable server-only interfaces have timeout, cancellation and validated responses. Deterministic fixtures enable offline work. No unapproved provider or spending.

issues.title: M2: Title embeddings and pgvector retrieval
issues.criteria: Resumable versioned embeddings of overview, genres and keywords use validated dimensions. Retrieve nearest 50 with a tested pgvector index strategy.

issues.title: M2: Guest taste vector and feedback updates
issues.criteria: Average valid seed embeddings with documented weighting; explicit likes/dislikes adjust bounded taste preferences, while watched only suppresses repeats unless accompanied by a rating. Treat skips as weak/ambiguous signals. Support zero-seed cold start. Tests distinguish each event, reject invalid vectors and prevent repeated-event drift.

issues.title: M2: Recommendation hard filters and exhaustion behavior
issues.criteria: Apply US services, explicit genre exclusions, format, length and watched exclusions BEFORE limiting the eligible retrieval pool, or use tested adaptive overfetch. Define length boundaries. Never silently relax constraints; explain shortages and ask which constraint to loosen. Test sparse service/genre combinations and cold-start fallback.

issues.title: M2: Candidate-only mood reranking and explanations
issues.criteria: Rank only eligible candidate IDs using explicit taste and mood signals, diversify near-duplicate franchises/genres, and return up to five distinct choices. Ground explanations in catalog metadata and user answers; never invent facts. Compare with deterministic baseline. Reject hallucinated IDs and use tested deterministic fallback on timeout, outage or invalid output.

issues.title: M2: Recommendation API with enforced LLM budgets
issues.criteria: Shared concurrency-safe session and IP quotas precede every paid embedding/rerank call, bound retries and fail closed. Tests prove rejected requests make zero provider calls. Typed API supports show-more and fixtures.

issues.title: M2: Thirty-case recommendation evaluation and latency
issues.criteria: Create at least 30 hand-reviewed cases spanning cold start, niche taste, mainstream taste, sparse services, exclusions and movies/series. Compare ranking to a simple deterministic baseline with documented rubrics; report hard-filter validity, availability freshness, diversity, explanation faithfulness, latency p50/p95 and failure rate. Quality claims require measured evidence, not just sensible-looking examples.

issues.title: M3: Four-screen shell and mock API contract
issues.criteria: Typed mock contract supports zero-seed cold start, optional 3-5 title quiz, loading, empty and error states. Four compact steps preserve answers and allow back/edit/skip. Quiz displays seed titles; only results display recommendations. Design one clear best match with four alternatives and a visible explanation of why it fits.

issues.title: M3: Streaming services selection screen
issues.criteria: Accessible multi-select grid; skipping defaults to all services. Persist selection and test keyboard and touch at phone and desktop sizes.

issues.title: M3: Taste quiz and avoided genres screen
issues.criteria: Optional searchable visual quiz accepts 3-5 favorite titles when used, or a clear skip for cold start; avoid forcing unfamiliar titles. Accessible selections and editable genre exclusions. Test missing posters, errors, skip and changing prior selections.

issues.title: M3: Mood, format and length screen
issues.criteria: Five moods and movie/series-specific length choices persist. Format changes discard incompatible length settings. Keyboard and phone tests pass.

issues.title: M3: Five-pick results and streaming links
issues.criteria: Present one best match plus up to four alternatives with grounded reasons, runtime/episode commitment, selected US streaming providers and freshness. Separate subscription availability from rent/buy; no false playback-deep-link claims. Accessible actions and clear shortage/unavailable states; never invent results.

issues.title: M3: Guest persistence and result feedback
issues.criteria: Versioned local storage restores guest preferences. Watched suppresses repeats without implying like; explicit like/dislike events update taste; show-more/skip is a weak signal. Undo feedback, edit preferences and handle corruption/offline state. Events are idempotent and collect only necessary data.

issues.title: M3: Full guest recommendation journey tests
issues.criteria: Phone and laptop Playwright cover both optional-quiz and zero-seed guest paths, filters, back/edit, undo, reload, errors and unavailable streaming links without accounts. Measure time to first useful result, interaction count and abandonment in consented usability sessions; target first recommendation within 60 seconds.

issues.title: M4: Optional Auth.js sign-in
issues.criteria: Owner configures approved auth provider. Sign-in remains optional; secure sessions, sign-out and guest continuity tested without secret exposure.

issues.title: M4: Guest-to-account merge and cross-device sync
issues.criteria: Idempotent conflict-aware merge preserves preferences and feedback. Test two-device conflicts and cross-account access rejection.

issues.title: M4: Installable PWA and safe offline behavior
issues.criteria: Manifest, icons and installation verified. Safe offline shell and update strategy; no credential or private recommendation caching.

issues.title: M4: Accessibility and responsive usability pass
issues.criteria: Check keyboard, focus, screen-reader labels, contrast, reduced motion and touch targets across full flow. Fix actionable findings and record evidence.

issues.title: M4: Privacy, deletion and production readiness
issues.criteria: Document stored data and retention. Implement deletion and redacted logging; validate quota and error behavior before public use.

issues.title: M5: Owner decision — availability source and commercial terms
issues.criteria: Research current official TMDB/JustWatch, Watchmode and Streaming Availability API terms, commercial use, deep links, coverage and prices. Recommend with sources. Owner decides before M5; do not purchase or switch providers without approval.

issues.title: M5: Recruit and onboard twenty beta users
issues.criteria: Owner approves outreach and consent. Twenty real users complete the flow; record anonymized evidence and service coverage without fabricated results.

issues.title: M5: Beta feedback and recommendation quality report
issues.criteria: With consent, measure time to first useful recommendation, which picks users would watch, streaming-link accuracy, reasons for rejection and return-session improvement. Compare personalized ranking with the deterministic baseline. Triage failures into linked issues and report real twenty-user evidence, uncertainties and prioritised fixes.

issues.title: M5: Beta release review and operational checklist
issues.criteria: CI and previews green. Owner approves public deployment only after quota, commercial, privacy and accessibility gates. Document rollback and retain US-only scope unless owner explicitly changes it.
